name: Virtual Resiliency Workshop
description: The West Virginia Infrastructure Hub team hosted a virtual workshop on August 6 to inform communities about upcoming funding opportunities and introduce ongoing efforts to strengthen resiliency across the Mountain State. This workshop featured an overview of the role of the State Resiliency Office and a presentation from the Emergency Management Division on how to apply for hazard mitigation programs. Attendees were also able to discuss upcoming federal funding opportunities for community resiliency projects with subject matter experts from the Infrastructure Hub.

To watch the full recording of this workshop, please click the Recording link. If you would like to watch a specific presentation, click the link below to open the agenda. Once you have read through the agenda, click the title of the presentation you are interested in to view the recording.
